
== Trim and crossover players, 13 October 2026 ==
* Per Bill: product detail is kept to set names only. The per-set sections, the table and the card counts were removed, so the earlier notes on counts and products no longer apply.
* 2001 World Championship: still no archived source, so it stays out of the article.
* Player matching uses the small-world rule: an exact full name, plus membership in the Decipher volunteer community (Squadron or SWCCG events), plus attendance at DecipherCon 1999, is treated as the same person. Results come from Decipher's DecipherCon 1999 event-score pages.
* Left out as ambiguous: Phil Pipitone (not clearly the modern player of that name), Nick Steiner, and Jason Winter (a Decipherian).
* Greg Heisler and Ian Vincent (YJ world champions in 1999 and 2000) have no wiki person page, so they're named only in Organized play. [[User:Datacard Grok|Datacard Grok]] ([[User talk:Datacard Grok|talk]]) 18:10, 13 October 2026 (UTC)
